svg.title: SAT check-availability workflow architecture
svg.desc: An hourly schedule starts a six-step Mastra workflow that logs in to the SAT citas site through one shared browser session, solves the CAPTCHA with a vision agent, checks availability, books the earliest slot using a token read from Gmail, and reports through PushBird.
svg.text: Playwright Chromium · Map<runId, {browser, page}> · opened by 01 · closed on booked, unavailable or error
POST webhook · time-sensitive push to phone
